title: moschosma moschatum
intro: Moschosma moschatum, commonly known as Muskroot or Musk-vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Moschosma moschatum include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve spasms, as well as its use as a diuretic to treat urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
